category.minecartvisualizer.title: Minecart Visualizer
yacl.option.enable_visualization.desc: Master switch: Controls all trails and info rendering.
yacl.option.always_facing.desc: Whether info text should always face the player's line of sight.
yacl.option.inventory_cols.desc: Number of slots to display per row in the inventory render. Wraps if exceeded.
yacl.option.fold_inventory.desc: If enabled, only renders the inventory of one minecart in a stack.
yacl.option.auto_size_columns.desc: Automatically adjusts row length. Overrides manual row length setting.
yacl.option.max_slots.desc: Automatically disables inventory rendering if total slots exceed this value. 0 for no limit.
yacl.option.tracker_time_unit.desc: Unit used to display tracker runtime.
yacl.option.speed_unit.desc: Unit used to calculate and display minecart speed.
yacl.group.hopper_filter.desc: Disabled hopper slots will not be rendered in the inventory view.
yacl.option.info_text_on_top.desc: When enabled, the floating minecart info text is drawn on top of everything (ignoring depth), so it stays visible through blocks and entities.
yacl.option.accuracy.desc: Number of decimal places for coordinates and speed.
yacl.option.hopper_visual_on_top.desc: When enabled, the pickup range box and extraction target highlight are drawn on top of everything (ignoring depth), so they stay visible through blocks and entities.
yacl.option.hopper_range_scale.desc: Scales the rendered range boxes. 1.0 (default) is exactly the vanilla area.
yacl.option.extraction_target_scale.desc: Scales the extraction target outline. 1.0 (default) matches the block outline shape / entity hitbox exactly.
yacl.group.colors.desc: Colors for every box and text drawn by this mod. Click a swatch to open the color picker.
yacl.option.color_pickup_range.desc: Color of the item pickup range box (HopperMinecartEntity: bounding box expanded by 0.25 blocks horizontally).
yacl.option.color_extraction_range.desc: Color of the input column above the hopper (Hopper.INPUT_AREA_SHAPE: 1x1, from +11/16 to +2 blocks).
yacl.option.color_extraction_target.desc: Color of the outline drawn on the container above the hopper / the container vehicle being extracted.
yacl.option.color_info_text.desc: Color of the floating text above minecarts.
yacl.option.color_item_count_text.desc: Color of the item stack count text inside rendered inventory slots.
yacl.option.color_slot_background.desc: Background color of rendered inventory slots.
yacl.option.color_slot_border.desc: Border color of rendered inventory slots.
yacl.option.color_slot_background_locked: Background color of slots excluded by the slot filter.
yacl.option.color_slot_border_locked.des: Border color of slots excluded by the slot filter.
yacl.option.color_tracker_point_active.d: Color of tracker points that still hold items.
yacl.option.color_tracker_point_inactive: Color of tracker points that no longer hold items.
yacl.option.color_tracker_trail.desc: Color of minecart trails when "Tracker Points Use Dye Color" is disabled.
yacl.option.inventory_slot_size.desc: Scales the rendered inventory slot backgrounds.
yacl.option.inventory_item_size.desc: Scales the item models inside rendered inventory slots.
yacl.option.max_trail_points.desc: Max points for trail rendering. Higher values allow for longer trails.
yacl.option.output_slot_change.desc: Output message to chat when minecart inventory changes.
yacl.option.output_destroyed.desc: Output message to chat when a minecart is destroyed.
yacl.option.output_on_increase.desc: Send a chat message when items are added to the minecart.
yacl.option.output_on_decrease.desc: Send a chat message when items are removed from the minecart.
yacl.option.print_inventory.desc: List the specific items and slot numbers in the chat message.
yacl.option.print_duration.desc: Display how long the minecart has been tracked (runtime) when it is destroyed.
yacl.option.print_coordinates.desc: Include clickable coordinates and teleport commands in the chat message.
yacl.option.tracking_by_dye.desc: Allows adding trackers by right-clicking minecarts with dyes.
yacl.group.collision.desc: Send a chat message when a tracked minecart is squeezed by a block or entity (it collides and loses momentum as a result). The squeeze itself is detected and reported by the server.
yacl.option.output_on_collision.desc: Master switch: send a chat message when a tracked minecart is squeezed.
yacl.option.collision_threshold.desc: Squeezes whose momentum change |dv| is below this value are not reported, which filters out minor grazes. Unit: blocks per game tick.
yacl.option.collision_cooldown.desc: Minimum interval between two squeeze messages for the same minecart. 0 disables the limit.
yacl.option.print_collision_position.des: Include the minecart position in squeeze messages (clickable for a teleport command).
yacl.option.print_collision_momentum.des: Include the momentum change in squeeze messages: |dv| and the dv vector.
yacl.option.print_collision_speed_change: Include the speed before/after the squeeze and their difference.
yacl.option.print_collision_target.desc: Include the object that squeezed the minecart (block or entity).
yacl.option.tracker_use_dye_color.desc: When enabled, tracker points and trails use the dye color instead of the configured color.
yacl.option.hopper_range.desc: Draws the two areas vanilla uses to search items: the cart bounding box expanded by 0.25 blocks horizontally, and the 1x1 input column above the hopper (Hopper.INPUT_AREA_SHAPE, from +11/16 to +2 blocks).
yacl.option.highlight_targets.desc: Draws the full outline of the extraction target (the container above, or a container vehicle) on top of everything.
